messages:
Rafael M: Heads-up: POLARIS SOLUTIONS (acct: POLARIS-330) invoice INV-3345 for $78,600 is 53 days past due. Card on file expired and AP says they need a revised invoice to include a PO number.
Tina F: Oof. They renewed during an expansion and requested net-60 but never provided PO. AP emailed: 'we can pay but need invoice with PO-7789 and employee tax ID for their audit team.'
BillingBot: Autopay failed for INV-3345. Reason: expired_card. Retry scheduled in 72 hours. Payment link: https://pay.redwood.ai/inv/INV-3345
Rafael M: CS flagged churn risk. Customer asked if we can accept a 4-month installment plan (4 equal monthly wires). They also requested a 1.5% handling fee waiver.
CS - Anya: Customer confirmed they'll sign the payment arrangement if we reissue invoice with PO and pause suspension. They want service uninterrupted.
Tina F: Proposed plan: 
- Total: $78,600
- 4 monthly payments: $19,650 starting on receipt of signed plan
- No late fees while plan is followed
- Reissue invoice to include PO-7789 and tax id as requested
- Require wire or ACH; no card retries
Rafael M: @Sam R (Legal) can we waive handling fee and defer suspending service while plan is active? Also any contract implications for 4-month plan?
Sam R (Legal): We can accept a documented payment plan. No permanent fee waivers without exec approval but temporary handling fee waiver ok for documented plan. Add clause: missing payment = breach and immediate right to suspend per contract. Capture signed acknowledgement.
CFO - Priya K: Approve the 4-month plan and handling fee waiver for this customer given expansion opportunity, but CFO wants ACH or wire and a senior exec sign-off on the acknowledgement. Also tag revenue team for recognition schedule.
Tina F: I'll reissue invoice as INV-3345-PO7789 and send payment plan email template to AP. Drafted copy below: 
"Polaris - Payment Plan Proposal:
- Invoice: INV-3345-PO7789 ($78,600)
- Payments: 4 x $19,650 on 1st of next 4 months, first due on receipt of signed plan
- Payment method: Wire or ACH only
- Handling fee waived for duration of plan
- If any payment missed, full balance becomes immediately due and service may be suspended"
BillingBot: Draft invoice INV-3345-PO7789 created. Payment link updated.
Rafael M: Sending to AP now and looping AM. I'll request exec sign-off once AP returns signed ack.
CollectionsBot: Flagging account: pause outbound collections while active plan exists. Reminder to follow up if payment not received by first due date (1743500000).
BillingBot: Payment of $19,650 scheduled (ACH pending) for INV-3345 (txn: SCHED-55123).
Tina F: AP sent signed acknowledgement and confirmed first wire will execute in 2 business days. They attached PO-7789 and tax id.
Rafael M: Received docs, obtaining exec sign-off now.
CFO - Priya K: Exec sign-off provided via email. Confirming handling fee waiver and plan terms.
BillingBot: Wire received: $19,650 (txn: WIRE-661234). Remaining balance: $58,950.
CS - Anya: Restored full service and updated renewal notes. Ticket CS-11002 updated with payment plan and docs.
Rafael M: Updating ledger and marking invoice status -> "Payment Plan Active". If second payment missed we will escalate to Collections and Legal.
Sam R (Legal): Please store signed ack and invoice revision in contract folder. If customer defaults, preserve escalation paperwork for potential recovery.
Tina F: Thanks team, keeping thread open until plan completes. :thumbsup:
